lines: Your people are your biggest cost.
So why are they still planned in a spreadsheet?
Every hire, raise and bonus lives in a different file.
Taxes and benefits are calculated by hand.
And the totals never quite match the budget in Financials.
Workforce Planning puts your people inside NetSuite Planning.
Every employee, every cost and every open role, in one model, connected to your P and L.
Salary, payroll taxes and benefits, calculated for every employee, every month.
New hires planned by department, before anyone is hired.
And compensation that lands in Financials automatically.
Here is how it works.
You set the rules once: tax rates and caps, benefit rates, and the month raises take effect.
Your roster comes in from payroll or NetSuite.
Each employee has a hire date, a salary basis, a pay rate, and how their cost splits across departments.
To add a hire, open New Hires and pick an open row.
Enter the job title, the start date and the salary.
Then run Update Workforce.
Planning does the math, month by month, from the start date forward.
Salary, social security up to its cap, Medicare, the 401k match and bonus.
Run Update Financials, and every dollar flows into the P and L.
Salaries, payroll taxes and benefits, by department and by account.
Then review total compensation by department, this year against next.
One number for the board, and every employee behind it.
Write to Bryant Park Consulting to plan your workforce in NetSuite Planning.
And get the most out of your implementation.
